svg.aria-label: Delivery loop: a push under apps/backend runs Backend CI, which logs in to Azure with OIDC, builds and pushes the image to ACR, and commits the new tag into k8s/. Argo CD syncs it and the kubelet pulls the image. A manual kubectl delete is reverted by selfHeal.
svg.title: Delivery loop: a push under apps/backend runs Backend CI, which logs in to Azure with OIDC, builds and pushes the image to ACR, and commits the new tag into k8s/. Argo CD syncs it and the kubelet pulls the image. A manual kubectl delete is reverted by selfHeal.

g.text: writes the new tag back to git
sees a new HEAD in k8s/
drift: someone runs kubectl delete deployment backend → selfHeal puts git's version back (8 s in drill 1)
